description: This file defines a serializer class for handling WebSocket communication with Telnyx in the Pipecat project. It manages encoding/decoding of audio streams, DTMF signals, and call control via Telnyx API, supporting features like auto hang-up and audio format conversions.

classes.name: TelnyxFrameSerializer
classes.description: Serializer for Telnyx WebSocket protocol, converting Pipecat frames to Telnyx media streams and vice versa, with call control and audio encoding features.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the serializer with stream ID, encodings, call control ID, API key, and parameters.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the serializer type, which is TEXT.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures the serializer with pipeline input sample rate from the StartFrame.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes Pipecat frames into Telnyx WebSocket messages, handling media, interruption, and call hang-up.

methods.name: _hang_up_call
methods.description: Makes an API call to Telnyx to hang up the current call, handling errors and call status.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Converts Telnyx WebSocket messages into Pipecat frames, including audio and DTMF events.
